base-b.about: rhp as it is, a second bundle (A/A control)

noguard.about: the guard's 42 resets gone (box-sizing kept, so a clean page draws the same)

guard-inherit.about: the guard keeps only its 25 inherit declarations (font, color, letter-spacing...)

guard-reset.about: the guard keeps only its 17 resets that aren't inherit (margin, padding, border, display...)

noprotect.about: every page-protection rule gone: guard, sizes, view-transition, [hidden], ::before/::after, ::selection

notransition.about: the CSS version's transition rules gone

noimportant.about: no !important anywhere (layers reversed so precedence among rhp's own rules stays the same)
